map.输入胬肉头端侵入、体部宽度与长度等测量值（mm），计算角膜侵入比例并判定分级。: Enter measurements in mm such as the pterygium head encroachment, body width and length to compute the corneal encroachment ratio and determine the grade.
map.测角膜横径 cd 与侵入距离 head，算覆盖比与面积。: Measure the corneal horizontal diameter cd and the encroachment distance head, then compute the coverage ratio and the area.
map.：角膜半径 = 11.5/2 = 5.75mm；覆盖比 = 2/5.75×100: Corneal radius = 11.5/2 = 5.75mm; coverage ratio = 2/5.75 x 100 = about 34.8%; area = 2 x 3 = 6mm2.
map.：head 接近半径（覆盖比→高）且累及光学区，手术指征更强。: When the head approaches the radius (coverage ratio rising) and involves the optical zone, the indication for surgery is stronger.
map.无绝对界值，但侵入瞳孔区、影响视力或反复炎症者通常建议手术。: There is no absolute cutoff, but lesions reaching the pupillary zone, affecting vision or recurring inflammation usually lead to a recommendation for surgery.
map.近似为侵入距离×颈部宽度（head×width），为规划用简化模型。: Approximated as encroachment distance x neck width (head x width), a simplified model for planning.
